# Pixel Painter — 16×16

A tiny offline pixel-art painter built with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

## Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server, build step, or network access required.

## Features

- 16×16 grid of paintable cells
- Palette of 6 colors
- Eraser tool
- Clear button resets the whole board
- Live count of painted cells
- Keyboard accessible: cells and controls are focusable buttons with labels; activate with Enter/Space
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide

## Files

- `index.html` — structure
- `styles.css` — theme and layout
- `app.js` — painting logic
